inspection.method: Visual inspection of the downloaded actual Chromium component captures at readable resolution; image hashes verified against provenance.json.
inspection.result: No loading failures, horizontal overflow, clipped labels or overlapping controls observed in these states. Narrow views scroll vertically; the selected row remains accessible.
inspection.limits: This is not an independent design review or a quantified contrast audit. The narrow-events capture is byte-identical to the previously inspected capture.

verification.packedConsumer: CommonJS, ESM, SSR and node/bundler TypeScript resolution passed for actual source and publish-directory tarballs
verification.browser: Light/dark desktop and 390px checks passed with no runtime errors; automated accessibility excludes color contrast
verification.cacheHarnessNote: The subsequent nonvisual CI integration adds all investigation harnesses to the browser-proof fingerprint. Existing browser-proof tests pass locally.

delegation.reason: Separate subagent tools were unavailable in this execution environment. No independent review or drafting is claimed.
